blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday stressed that her purpose is not to become the next president of the country, but to spread her message on the “country’s problems and what needs to be done.” Duterte made the pronouncement in a speech at the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry 52nd Philippine Business Conference and Expo, where she spoke about her current experiences as the vice president.
